| description = A rare named mermaid swimming in the shallows of Erud's Crossing. Wanders from her spawn point to the sandy beach at (-690, 910, -16) and swims back again. She does not have a PH, rather, the seahorse that paths from the shore in front of Tolo out to the other seahorses is what triggers her to spawn. She will spawn out where the other seahorses are and start pathing to shore. There are 3 seahorses in the water, 1 is completely static on the left (when looking out at the water), a second paths a very short distance and returns closely to the static one. You can ignore these 2. The seahorse that is furthest to the right paths closely to the shore and back towards the other seahorses. This is the one you want to kill to try and trigger Hastashi to spawn. She does not spawn every time you kill this seahorse. Also, I'm not sure if it matters, but I have only seen her at night.
